scope: Exploratory only: repeated complete first navigation construction with 16/64/16 MiB writer caches; no producer or reindex staging. Same base facts, serial order and warm filesystem/allocator confounding; informs an implementation tradeoff, not acceptance numbers.
decision: Rejected: 64 MiB was slower than either 16 MiB sample; production cache remains 16 MiB. Exploratory methodology is not the publication acceptance benchmark.
